description: Implementation of a service class for reading savings account charges in the Fineract platform, including methods for retrieving charge details, templates, and charges with due or upcoming fees.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to read savings account charges and related data.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to SavingsAccountChargeData objects.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeDueMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to SavingsAccountAnnualFeeData objects related to charge due dates.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountChargeTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template with options for creating or editing a savings account charge.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountChargeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific savings account charge by ID and account ID.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountCharges
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of charges for a given savings account, filtered by active/inactive status.

methods.name: retrieveChargesWithAnnualFeeDue
methods.description: Retrieves charges with upcoming annual fee due dates.

methods.name: retrieveChargesWithDue
methods.description: Retrieves charges that are due or overdue.
